verses.1: Before the Passover meal, Jesus knew that it was time for him to leave this world and go to his Father. He loved those who were dear to him in this world until the end.
verses.2: And after the meal was over, he had already accepted the gift into his heart, so that Judas Simon Iscariot could give it to him.
verses.3: You know that his father gave him everything in his hands. And it’s from God that he came, and to God he also returns.
verses.4: He got up from the dinner table, put on his clothes, and, taking a lantern, he lit himself up.
verses.5: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the students’ feet with it. He also used it to clean the cloth that was covered in blood.
verses.6: So, he comes to Simon Peter. He says to him, “Lord, will you wash my feet?”
verses.7: Jesus replied to him, “What I am about to do, you do not know now, but you will know later.”
verses.8: Peter said to him, “Do not put my feet in the fire.” Jesus replied to him, “If I do not put you in danger, then you have no place with me.”
verses.9: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, do not harm my feet alone; also do not hurt my hands and my head.”
verses.10: Jesus said to him, “The leper has no need to wash his feet; he is already clean. You also are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.11: For he knows that what is being given to him is not pure at all. That’s why he said that not everything is pure.
verses.12: And then, as their feet grew stronger, they took hold of his clothes and fell down. Again, he said to them, “Tell me what I have done for you.”
verses.13: You people speak to me as if I were the teacher and the Lord. And you say that right, indeed.
verses.14: If I have indeed grown up watching you, then the Lord and teacher have taught you how to wash your feet. And it’s your responsibility to wash each other’s feet.
verses.15: For I have given you an example to follow, so that you may do as I have done.
verses.16: I say to you, indeed, there is no slave greater than his master, nor any apostle greater than the one who sent him.
verses.17: If you know all this, then it would be good if you could do those things.
verses.18: I’m not speaking about everything related to you. I know that I’ve chosen some people for this role. But it’s necessary for the task to be completed. The one who ate my bread took his wing and flew away from me.
verses.19: I tell you this before it happens, so that when it becomes true that I am indeed who I say I am, you can believe in it.
verses.20: Indeed, I say to you: whoever receives something from me, he will receive it; and whoever sends something to me, he will receive what he sent.
verses.21: While Jesus said these things, he was filled with the Spirit. He testified and said, “Truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me.”
verses.22: The disciples looked at each other, unable to decide what to say.
verses.23: One of His disciples was lying down in the garden where Jesus was. This disciple was someone whom Jesus loved very much.
verses.24: So, Simon Peter thinks that it must be something related to what he’s talking about.
verses.25: As he fell there, he said to Jesus, “Lord, who are you?”
verses.26: Jesus answers: “This is the one for whom I will wash the bread and give it to him. After you have washed the bread, give it to Judas Simon Iscariot.”
verses.27: And after the bread was given, Satan entered there at that time. Jesus said to him, “What do you want?”
verses.28: But none of those present knew what he said to them.
verses.29: For some people thought that since Judas had a copy of the scriptures, it meant that Jesus was telling him to use those scriptures for the feast day, or to give them to the poor.
verses.30: So, after taking the bread, he left immediately. It was night at that time.
verses.31: “And now,” said Jesus, “the Son of Man has been glorified. And God has been glorified in him.”
verses.32: If the Lord is glorified in him, then the Lord will also glorify him in himself. And soon, he will be glorified as well.
verses.33: I am still too young to be with you. Please ask me. As I said to the Jews, “Wherever I lead you, you cannot go there.” Now, I tell you that it’s already too late.
verses.34: I give you a new command: to love one another, just as I have loved you.
verses.35: In this, everyone realizes that you are my disciples, if you truly love each other.
verses.36: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where should I go?” Jesus replied, “I cannot take you now. You will follow me later.”
verses.37: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you as a servant? I will give my soul for you.”
verses.38: Jesus replies, “Will you lay your soul at my disposal?” I say to you, yes, I will. Do not speak in a hesitant manner until you deny me three times.
